<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>✦ 塔罗 · 秘仪抽卡 ✦</title>
    <style>
        /* ===== 全局 ===== */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=MedievalSharp&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;700&display=swap');

        :root {
            --gold: #d4a74a;
            --gold-light: #f0d080;
            --gold-dark: #b8923a;
            --bg-dark: #0b0a0c;
            --bg-card: #1a171e;
            --text-light: #e8e0d8;
            --text-muted: #a09088;
            --shadow-gold: 0 0 50px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.2);
        }

        body {
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 20%, rgba(90, 50, 30, 0.25) 0%, transparent 60%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 80%, rgba(60, 40, 80, 0.2) 0%, transparent 60%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
            padding: 1.5rem;
            position: relative;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        /* ===== 星星 ===== */
        .stars {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .star {
            position: absolute;
            width: 2px;
            height: 2px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: twinkle var(--d, 3s) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }
        @keyframes twinkle {
            0% {
                opacity: 0.15;
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1.2);
            }
        }

        /* ===== 主容器 ===== */
        .container {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 900px;
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        /* ===== 标题 ===== */
        .header {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
        }
        .header h1 {
            font-family: 'MedievalSharp', cursive;
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.3);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
        }
        .header p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            margin-top: 0.2rem;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        /* ===== 模式切换 ===== */
        .mode-selector {
            display: flex;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15);
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
        }
        .mode-btn {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-family: 'Noto Serif SC', serif;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 1.6rem;
            border-radius: 40px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            font-weight: 400;
        }
        .mode-btn:hover {
            color: var(--gold-light);
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.08);
        }
        .mode-btn.active {
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15);
            color: var(--gold);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.2);
        }

        /* ===== 牌桌 ===== */
        .table {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(30, 25, 35, 0.6), rgba(10, 8, 12, 0.8));
            border-radius: 40px;
            padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.08);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), var(--shadow-gold);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 420px;
            transition: min-height 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===== 卡片槽容器 ===== */
        .cards-container {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 2.5rem;
            width: 100%;
            min-height: 300px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }

        /* ===== 单张卡牌 ===== */
        .card-slot {
            perspective: 1400px;
            width: 200px;
            aspect-ratio: 5 / 8;
            cursor: default;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease, opacity 0.4s ease;
        }
        .card-slot.waiting {
            opacity: 0.4;
            filter: grayscale(0.6);
        }
        .card-slot .card-inner {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
            transform-style: preserve-3d;
            border-radius: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
        }
        .card-slot.revealed .card-inner {
            transform: rotateY(180deg);
        }

        .card-face {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            backface-visibility: hidden;
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem;
            border: 2px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.25);
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            background: var(--bg-card);
        }
        .card-back {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #2a1f2a, #0e0a10);
            border-color: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.3);
        }
        .card-back .back-design {
            width: 85%;
            height: 85%;
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05), transparent);
        }
        .card-back .back-design::before {
            content: '✦';
            font-size: 3.8rem;
            color: var(--gold);
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.2);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .card-back .back-design .ornament {
            position: absolute;
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            opacity: 0.25;
        }
        .card-back .back-design .ornament.top {
            top: 12px;
        }
        .card-back .back-design .ornament.bottom {
            bottom: 12px;
        }

        .card-front {
            transform: rotateY(180deg);
            background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1f1a22, #121016);
            border-color: var(--gold);
            padding: 1rem 0.6rem;
            text-align: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0.2rem;
        }
        .card-front .number {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--gold);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            opacity: 0.5;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .card-front .symbol {
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            line-height: 1.2;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15));
        }
        .card-front .title {
            font-family: 'MedievalSharp', cursive;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: var(--gold-light);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.1);
        }
        .card-front .subtitle {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }
        .card-front .divider {
            width: 50%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--gold), transparent);
            margin: 0.3rem auto;
            opacity: 0.3;
        }
        .card-front .meaning {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            line-height: 1.5;
            max-width: 90%;
            opacity: 0.8;
            font-weight: 300;
            margin-top: 0.1rem;
        }
        .card-front .meaning span {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.4;
            margin-top: 0.2rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .slot-label {
            text-align: center;
            margin-top: 0.6rem;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            opacity: 0.3;
            font-weight: 300;
            transition: opacity 0.6s ease;
        }
        .card-slot.revealed .slot-label {
            opacity: 0.6;
            color: var(--gold-light);
        }

        /* ===== 抽牌按钮 ===== */
        .draw-area {
            margin-top: 2rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .draw-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15), rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05));
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.3);
            color: var(--gold-light);
            font-family: 'MedievalSharp', cursive;
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            padding: 0.8rem 3.5rem;
            border-radius: 60px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05);
        }
        .draw-btn:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.25), rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.08));
            border-color: var(--gold);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 10px 50px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15);
        }
        .draw-btn:active {
            transform: scale(0.96);
        }
        .draw-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.3;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none !important;
        }

        /* ===== 解读 ===== */
        .reading-box {
            margin-top: 1.8rem;
            padding: 1.2rem 1.8rem;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 16px;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            min-height: 70px;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 600px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 0.5s ease;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(10px);
        }
        .reading-box.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .reading-box .reading-title {
            color: var(--gold);
            font-family: 'MedievalSharp', cursive;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .reading-box .reading-desc {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            margin-top: 0.3rem;
            line-height: 1.6;
            opacity: 0.8;
        }
        .reading-box .reading-desc strong {
            color: var(--gold-light);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        /* ===== 洗牌动画 ===== */
        @keyframes shuffleGlow {
            0%,
            100% {
                filter: brightness(1) drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0));
            }
            50% {
                filter: brightness(1.3) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.3));
            }
        }
        .card-slot.shuffling .card-inner {
            animation: shuffleGlow 0.3s ease-in-out 4;
        }

        /* ============================================================
           历史记录面板
           ============================================================ */
        .history-panel {
            margin-top: 2rem;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 800px;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.1);
            padding-top: 1.2rem;
        }

        .history-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: background 0.3s;
            user-select: none;
        }
        .history-header:hover {
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.05);
        }
        .history-header .left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .history-header .left .icon {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }
        .history-header .left .count {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.12);
            padding: 0.1rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .history-header .arrow {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }
        .history-header .arrow.open {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        .history-body {
            overflow: hidden;
            max-height: 0;
            transition: max-height 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), opacity 0.4s ease;
            opacity: 0;
        }
        .history-body.open {
            max-height: 600px;
            opacity: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin-top: 0.8rem;
        }
        .history-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }
        .history-body::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }
        .history-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.25);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        /* ===== 历史记录列表 ===== */
        .history-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.6rem;
        }

        .history-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.06);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .history-item:hover {
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.06);
            border-color: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.15);
            transform: translateX(4px);
        }
        .history-item .info {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.2rem;
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .history-item .info .time {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            opacity: 0.4;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .history-item .info .cards-summary {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-light);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .history-item .info .cards-summary .mode-tag {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.1);
            padding: 0.05rem 0.6rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: var(--gold);
            opacity: 0.6;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .history-item .info .cards-summary .card-names {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .history-item .info .cards-summary .card-names .name-chip {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            background: rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.06);
            padding: 0.05rem 0.6rem;
            border-radius: 10px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        .history-item .action {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            opacity: 0.2;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
            margin-left: 0.8rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .history-item:hover .action {
            opacity: 0.5;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .history-item .delete-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            opacity: 0.15;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin-left: 0.3rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .history-item .delete-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.8;
            color: #c0392b;
            background: rgba(192, 57, 43, 0.1);
        }

        .history-empty {
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            opacity: 0.3;
            padding: 1.5rem 0;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }

        .history-footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            margin-top: 0.8rem;
            padding-top: 0.6rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 167, 74, 0.04);
        }
        .clear-history-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            opacity: 0.2;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
        .clear-history-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.6;
            color: #c0392b;
            background: rgba(192, 57, 43, 0.05);
        }

        /* ===== 响应式 ===== */
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .header h1 {
                font-size: 2rem;
            }
            .card-slot {
                width: 150px;
            }
            .cards-container {
                gap: 1.2rem;
            }
            .card-front .symbol {
                font-size: 2.2rem;
            }
            .card-front .title {
                font-size: 1rem;
            }
            .draw-btn {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
                padding: 0.6rem 2.2rem;
            }
            .mode-btn {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
                padding: 0.3rem 1rem;
            }
            .table {
                padding: 1.5rem 0.8rem;
                min-height: 340px;
            }
            .history-item .info .cards-summary {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            .history-header .left {
                font-size: 0.85rem;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .card-slot {
                width: 120px;
            }
            .cards-container {
                gap: 0.8rem;
            }
            .card-front .symbol {
                font-size: 1.8rem;
            }
            .card-front .title {
                font-size: 0.8rem;
            }
            .card-front .meaning {
                font-size: 0.5rem;
            }
            .reading-box .reading-desc {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            .mode-selector {
                gap: 0.5rem;
                padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            }
            .mode-btn {
                font-size: 0.65rem;
                padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem;
            }
            .table {
                padding: 1rem 0.4rem;
                min-height: 280px;
            }
            .history-item {
                padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }
            .history-item .info .cards-summary .card-names .name-chip {
                font-size: 0.6rem;
            }
            .history-header .left .count {
                font-size: 0.6rem;
                padding: 0.05rem 0.5rem;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ===== 星星 ===== -->
    <div class="stars" id="stars"></div>

    <!-- ===== 主容器 ===== -->
    <div class="container">
        <header class="header">
            <h1>✦ 秘仪 · 抽卡 ✦</h1>
            <p>—— 洗牌凝神 · 点击揭示 ——</p>
        </header>

        <!-- 模式切换 -->
        <div class="mode-selector" id="modeSelector">
            <button class="mode-btn active" data-mode="single">✦ 抽 1 张</button>
            <button class="mode-btn" data-mode="triple">✦ 抽 3 张</button>
        </div>

        <!-- 牌桌 -->
        <div class="table" id="tableArea">
            <div class="cards-container" id="cardsContainer">
                <!-- 由 JS 动态渲染 -->
            </div>

            <!-- 抽牌按钮 -->
            <div class="draw-area">
                <button class="draw-btn" id="drawBtn">✦ 洗牌抽卡 ✦</button>
            </div>

            <!-- 解读框 -->
            <div class="reading-box" id="readingBox">
                <div class="reading-title" id="readingTitle"></div>
                <div class="reading-desc" id="readingDesc"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ===== 历史记录面板 ===== -->
        <div class="history-panel" id="historyPanel">
            <div class="history-header" id="historyToggle">
                <div class="left">
                    <span class="icon">📜</span>
                    <span>占卜手札</span>
                    <span class="count" id="historyCount">0</span>
                </div>
                <span class="arrow" id="historyArrow">▼</span>
            </div>

            <div class="history-body" id="historyBody">
                <div class="history-list" id="historyList">
                    <!-- 由 JS 渲染 -->
                </div>
                <div class="history-footer">
                    <button class="clear-history-btn" id="clearHistoryBtn">✧ 清空记录 ✧</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // ============================================================
        //  塔罗牌数据（22 张大阿尔卡纳）
        // ============================================================
        const tarotData = [{
            number: '0',
            name: '愚者',

        // ============================================================
        //  存储模块（优先 JsBridge，降级 localStorage，最后内存）
        // ============================================================
        const Storage = {
            _memory: {},

            _getBridge() {
                if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.JsBridge && typeof window.JsBridge.saveData ===
                    'function') {
                    return window.JsBridge;
                }
                return null;
            },

            _isLocalStorageAvailable() {
                try {
                    const test = '__storage_test__';
                    localStorage.setItem(test, test);
                    localStorage.removeItem(test);
                    return true;
                } catch (_) {
                    return false;
                }
            },

            save(key, value) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.saveData(key, String(value));
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
                        return true;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                // 内存存储
                this._memory[key] = String(value);
                return true;
            },

            load(key, defaultValue = '') {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        const val = bridge.loadData(key);
                        if (val !== undefined && val !== null && val !== '') return val;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        if (val !== null) return val;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (key in this._memory) {
                    return this._memory[key];
                }
                return defaultValue;
            },

            remove(key) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.deleteData(key);
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.removeItem(key);
                        return true;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                delete this._memory[key];
                return true;
            },

            has(key) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.hasData(key);
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        return localStorage.getItem(key) !== null;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                return key in this._memory;
            }

        // ============================================================

        const HISTORY_KEY = 'tarot_history';

        const HistoryManager = {
            // 获取所有记录
            getAll() {
                try {
                    const data = Storage.load(HISTORY_KEY, '[]');
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
                    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
                } catch (_) {
                    return [];
                }

            // 保存记录
            save(record) {
                const records = this.getAll();
                // 确保 id 唯一
                if (!record.id) {
                    record.id = Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
                }
                records.unshift(record); // 最新在前
                Storage.save(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
                return record;
            },

            // 删除单条
            delete(id) {
                let records = this.getAll();
                records = records.filter(r => r.id !== id);
                Storage.save(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
                return records;

            // 清空所有
            clear() {

            // 获取数量
            count() {
                return this.getAll().length;

            makeSummary(record) {

                return `${mode} · ${names}`;
            }

        // ============================================================

        let currentMode = 'single';
        let isDrawing = false;

        let currentIsHistory = false; // 是否正在查看历史

        const container = document.getElementById('cardsContainer');
        const drawBtn = document.getElementById('drawBtn');
        const readingBox = document.getElementById('readingBox');
        const readingTitle = document.getElementById('readingTitle');
        const readingDesc = document.getElementById('readingDesc');
        const historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');
        const historyCount = document.getElementById('historyCount');
        const historyBody = document.getElementById('historyBody');
        const historyToggle = document.getElementById('historyToggle');
        const historyArrow = document.getElementById('historyArrow');
        const clearHistoryBtn = document.getElementById('clearHistoryBtn');

        // ============================================================

                this.classList.add('active');
                currentMode = this.dataset.mode;

        // ============================================================

        function renderCards(cards, labels = null) {
            const count = currentMode === 'single' ? 1 : 3;
            container.innerHTML = '';

            const hasData = cards && cards.length > 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const slot = document.createElement('div');
                slot.className = 'card-slot waiting';
                if (hasData && cards[i]) {
                    slot.classList.remove('waiting');
                }

                const inner = document.createElement('div');
                inner.className = 'card-inner';

                // 牌背

                back.className = 'card-face card-back';
                back.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="back-design">
                        <span class="ornament top">✧ ✧ ✧</span>
                        <span class="ornament bottom">✧ ✧ ✧</span>
                    </div>
                `;

                // 牌面
                const front = document.createElement('div');
                front.className = 'card-face card-front';
                if (hasData && cards[i]) {
                    const c = cards[i];
                    front.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="number">${c.number}</div>
                        <div class="symbol">${c.symbol}</div>
                        <div class="title">${c.name}</div>
                        <div class="subtitle">${c.nameEn}</div>
                        <div class="divider"></div>
                        <div class="meaning">${c.meaning}<span>${c.detail}</span></div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    front.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="symbol" style="opacity:0.1;">✧</div>
                        <div class="title" style="opacity:0.1;">——</div>
                    `;
                }

                inner.appendChild(back);
                inner.appendChild(front);
                slot.appendChild(inner);

                // 标签
                const label = document.createElement('div');
                label.className = 'slot-label';
                if (labels && labels[i]) {
                    label.textContent = labels[i];
                } else if (count === 1) {
                    label.textContent = '✦ 今日之运 ✦';
                } else {
                    const defaultLabels = ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];
                    label.textContent = defaultLabels[i] || '✧';
                }
                slot.appendChild(label);

                container.appendChild(slot);
            }

            // 如果有数据，自动翻转
            if (hasData) {
                const slots = container.querySelectorAll('.card-slot');
                slots.forEach((slot, idx) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        slot.classList.remove('waiting');
                        slot.classList.add('revealed');
                    }, 300 + idx * 500);
                });
            }

            currentCards = cards || [];
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  重置牌桌（显示等待状态）
        // ============================================================
        function resetTable() {
            readingBox.classList.remove('show');
            readingTitle.textContent = '';
            readingDesc.textContent = '';
            currentIsHistory = false;
            renderCards([]);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  抽牌逻辑
        // ============================================================
        function drawRandomCards(n) {
            const shuffled = [...tarotData];
            for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [shuffled[i], shuffled[j]] = [shuffled[j], shuffled[i]];
            }
            return shuffled.slice(0, n);
        }

        function performDraw() {
            if (isDrawing) return;
            isDrawing = true;
            drawBtn.disabled = true;
            readingBox.classList.remove('show');

            const count = currentMode === 'single' ? 1 : 3;
            renderCards([]);

            const slots = container.querySelectorAll('.card-slot');
            slots.forEach(slot => {
                slot.classList.add('shuffling');
                slot.style.transform = `rotate(${Math.random()*6-3}deg)`;
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                const drawn = drawRandomCards(count);
                const labels = currentMode === 'single' ? ['✦ 今日之运 ✦'] : ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];
                renderCards(drawn, labels);

                document.querySelectorAll('.card-slot').forEach(s => {
                    s.classList.remove('shuffling');
                    s.style.transform = '';
                });

                // 显示解读
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showReading(drawn);
                    // 保存历史记录
                    saveHistoryRecord(drawn);
                    isDrawing = false;
                    drawBtn.disabled = false;
                    currentIsHistory = false;
                }, 600 + count * 400);

            }, 800);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  显示解读
        // ============================================================
        function showReading(cards) {
            if (!cards || cards.length === 0) return;
            if (cards.length === 1) {
                const c = cards[0];
                readingTitle.textContent = `✦ ${c.name} · ${c.nameEn} ✦`;
                readingDesc.innerHTML = `<strong>${c.meaning}</strong> · ${c.detail}`;
            } else {
                const parts = cards.map((c, i) => {
                    const labels = ['过去', '现在', '未来'];
                    return `<strong>${labels[i]}</strong> ${c.name}（${c.meaning}）`;
                });
                readingTitle.textContent = `✦ 过去 · 现在 · 未来 ✦`;
                readingDesc.innerHTML = parts.join(' ｜ ');
            }
            readingBox.classList.add('show');
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  保存历史记录
        // ============================================================
        function saveHistoryRecord(cards) {
            if (!cards || cards.length === 0) return;
            const record = {
                id: Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                mode: currentMode,
                cards: cards.map(c => ({ ...c })), // 深拷贝
                summary: HistoryManager.makeSummary({ mode: currentMode, cards })
            };
            HistoryManager.save(record);
            updateHistoryUI();
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  历史记录 UI
        // ============================================================
        function updateHistoryUI() {
            const records = HistoryManager.getAll();
            historyCount.textContent = records.length;

            if (records.length === 0) {
                historyList.innerHTML = `<div class="history-empty">✦ 尚未留下占卜记录 ✦</div>`;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            records.forEach(record => {
                const time = new Date(record.timestamp);
                const timeStr =
                    `${time.getFullYear()}/${String(time.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(time.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(time.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(time.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
                const modeLabel = record.mode === 'single' ? '单张' : '三张';
                const cardNames = record.cards.map(c =>
                    `<span class="name-chip">${c.symbol} ${c.name}</span>`
                ).join('');

                html += `
                    <div class="history-item" data-id="${record.id}">
                        <div class="info">
                            <div class="time">${timeStr}</div>
                            <div class="cards-summary">
                                <span class="mode-tag">${modeLabel}</span>
                                <span class="card-names">${cardNames}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        </div>
                    </div>

            historyList.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(item => {

                    const id = this.dataset.id;

                        viewHistoryRecord(record);
                    }

            // 事件：删除按钮

                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const id = this.dataset.id;
                    if (confirm('确定要删除这条占卜记录吗？')) {
                        HistoryManager.delete(id);
                        updateHistoryUI();
                        // 如果当前查看的正好是这条，重置牌桌
                        if (currentIsHistory && currentCards.length > 0) {
                            const firstCard = currentCards[0];
                            if (firstCard && firstCard.id && firstCard.id === id) {
                                resetTable();
                            }
                        }
                        // 更新计数
                        historyCount.textContent = HistoryManager.count();
                    }
                });
            });

        // ============================================================
        //  查看历史记录详情

        function viewHistoryRecord(record) {

            const count = cards.length;

            const labels = count === 1 ? ['✦ 历史占卜 ✦'] : ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];

                showReading(cards);
                currentIsHistory = true;
                // 高亮当前查看的记录
                document.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(el => {
                    el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(212,167,74,0)';

                        el.style.background = 'rgba(212,167,74,0.05)';
                    } else {

        // ============================================================
        //  历史面板折叠
        // ============================================================

        // ============================================================

        // ============================================================
        //  存储模块（优先 JsBridge，降级 localStorage，最后内存）
        // ============================================================
        const Storage = {
            _memory: {},

            _getBridge() {
                if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.JsBridge && typeof window.JsBridge.saveData ===
                    'function') {
                    return window.JsBridge;
                }
                return null;
            },

            _isLocalStorageAvailable() {
                try {
                    const test = '__storage_test__';
                    localStorage.setItem(test, test);
                    localStorage.removeItem(test);
                    return true;
                } catch (_) {
                    return false;
                }
            },

            save(key, value) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.saveData(key, String(value));
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(key, String(value));
                        return true;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                // 内存存储
                this._memory[key] = String(value);
                return true;
            },

            load(key, defaultValue = '') {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        const val = bridge.loadData(key);
                        if (val !== undefined && val !== null && val !== '') return val;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        if (val !== null) return val;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (key in this._memory) {
                    return this._memory[key];
                }
                return defaultValue;
            },

            remove(key) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.deleteData(key);
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        localStorage.removeItem(key);
                        return true;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                delete this._memory[key];
                return true;
            },

            has(key) {
                const bridge = this._getBridge();
                if (bridge) {
                    try {
                        return bridge.hasData(key);
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                if (this._isLocalStorageAvailable()) {
                    try {
                        return localStorage.getItem(key) !== null;
                    } catch (_) { /* 降级 */ }
                }
                return key in this._memory;
            }
        };

        // ============================================================
        //  历史记录管理器
        // ============================================================
        const HISTORY_KEY = 'tarot_history';

        const HistoryManager = {
            // 获取所有记录
            getAll() {
                try {
                    const data = Storage.load(HISTORY_KEY, '[]');
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(data);
                    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
                } catch (_) {
                    return [];
                }
            },

            // 保存记录
            save(record) {
                const records = this.getAll();
                // 确保 id 唯一
                if (!record.id) {
                    record.id = Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6);
                }
                records.unshift(record); // 最新在前
                Storage.save(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
                return record;
            },

            // 删除单条
            delete(id) {
                let records = this.getAll();
                records = records.filter(r => r.id !== id);
                Storage.save(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
                return records;
            },

            // 清空所有
            clear() {
                Storage.save(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify([]));
            },

            // 获取数量
            count() {
                return this.getAll().length;
            },

            // 生成摘要
            makeSummary(record) {
                const mode = record.mode === 'single' ? '单张' : '三张';
                const names = record.cards.map(c => c.name).join(' · ');
                return `${mode} · ${names}`;
            }
        };

        // ============================================================
        //  抽卡核心逻辑
        // ============================================================
        let currentMode = 'single';
        let isDrawing = false;
        let currentCards = []; // 当前展示的牌
        let currentIsHistory = false; // 是否正在查看历史

        const container = document.getElementById('cardsContainer');
        const drawBtn = document.getElementById('drawBtn');
        const readingBox = document.getElementById('readingBox');
        const readingTitle = document.getElementById('readingTitle');
        const readingDesc = document.getElementById('readingDesc');
        const historyList = document.getElementById('historyList');
        const historyCount = document.getElementById('historyCount');
        const historyBody = document.getElementById('historyBody');
        const historyToggle = document.getElementById('historyToggle');
        const historyArrow = document.getElementById('historyArrow');
        const clearHistoryBtn = document.getElementById('clearHistoryBtn');

        // ============================================================
        //  模式切换
        // ============================================================
        document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (isDrawing) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                this.classList.add('active');
                currentMode = this.dataset.mode;
                // 重置牌桌（清空当前牌，显示等待状态）
                resetTable();
                // 收起历史面板
                closeHistoryPanel();
            });
        });

        // ============================================================
        //  渲染卡牌
        // ============================================================
        function renderCards(cards, labels = null) {
            const count = currentMode === 'single' ? 1 : 3;
            container.innerHTML = '';

            const hasData = cards && cards.length > 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const slot = document.createElement('div');
                slot.className = 'card-slot waiting';
                if (hasData && cards[i]) {
                    slot.classList.remove('waiting');
                }

                const inner = document.createElement('div');
                inner.className = 'card-inner';

                // 牌背
                const back = document.createElement('div');
                back.className = 'card-face card-back';
                back.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="back-design">
                        <span class="ornament top">✧ ✧ ✧</span>
                        <span class="ornament bottom">✧ ✧ ✧</span>
                    </div>
                `;

                // 牌面
                const front = document.createElement('div');
                front.className = 'card-face card-front';
                if (hasData && cards[i]) {
                    const c = cards[i];
                    front.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="number">${c.number}</div>
                        <div class="symbol">${c.symbol}</div>
                        <div class="title">${c.name}</div>
                        <div class="subtitle">${c.nameEn}</div>
                        <div class="divider"></div>
                        <div class="meaning">${c.meaning}<span>${c.detail}</span></div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    front.innerHTML = `
                        <div class="symbol" style="opacity:0.1;">✧</div>
                        <div class="title" style="opacity:0.1;">——</div>
                    `;
                }

                inner.appendChild(back);
                inner.appendChild(front);
                slot.appendChild(inner);

                // 标签
                const label = document.createElement('div');
                label.className = 'slot-label';
                if (labels && labels[i]) {
                    label.textContent = labels[i];
                } else if (count === 1) {
                    label.textContent = '✦ 今日之运 ✦';
                } else {
                    const defaultLabels = ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];
                    label.textContent = defaultLabels[i] || '✧';
                }
                slot.appendChild(label);

                container.appendChild(slot);
            }

            // 如果有数据，自动翻转
            if (hasData) {
                const slots = container.querySelectorAll('.card-slot');
                slots.forEach((slot, idx) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        slot.classList.remove('waiting');
                        slot.classList.add('revealed');
                    }, 300 + idx * 500);
                });
            }

            currentCards = cards || [];
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  重置牌桌（显示等待状态）
        // ============================================================
        function resetTable() {
            readingBox.classList.remove('show');
            readingTitle.textContent = '';
            readingDesc.textContent = '';
            currentIsHistory = false;
            renderCards([]);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  抽牌逻辑
        // ============================================================
        function drawRandomCards(n) {
            const shuffled = [...tarotData];
            for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [shuffled[i], shuffled[j]] = [shuffled[j], shuffled[i]];
            }
            return shuffled.slice(0, n);
        }

        function performDraw() {
            if (isDrawing) return;
            isDrawing = true;
            drawBtn.disabled = true;
            readingBox.classList.remove('show');

            const count = currentMode === 'single' ? 1 : 3;
            renderCards([]);

            const slots = container.querySelectorAll('.card-slot');
            slots.forEach(slot => {
                slot.classList.add('shuffling');
                slot.style.transform = `rotate(${Math.random()*6-3}deg)`;
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                const drawn = drawRandomCards(count);
                const labels = currentMode === 'single' ? ['✦ 今日之运 ✦'] : ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];
                renderCards(drawn, labels);

                document.querySelectorAll('.card-slot').forEach(s => {
                    s.classList.remove('shuffling');
                    s.style.transform = '';
                });

                // 显示解读
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showReading(drawn);
                    // 保存历史记录
                    saveHistoryRecord(drawn);
                    isDrawing = false;
                    drawBtn.disabled = false;
                    currentIsHistory = false;
                }, 600 + count * 400);

            }, 800);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  显示解读
        // ============================================================
        function showReading(cards) {
            if (!cards || cards.length === 0) return;
            if (cards.length === 1) {
                const c = cards[0];
                readingTitle.textContent = `✦ ${c.name} · ${c.nameEn} ✦`;
                readingDesc.innerHTML = `<strong>${c.meaning}</strong> · ${c.detail}`;
            } else {
                const parts = cards.map((c, i) => {
                    const labels = ['过去', '现在', '未来'];
                    return `<strong>${labels[i]}</strong> ${c.name}（${c.meaning}）`;
                });
                readingTitle.textContent = `✦ 过去 · 现在 · 未来 ✦`;
                readingDesc.innerHTML = parts.join(' ｜ ');
            }
            readingBox.classList.add('show');
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  保存历史记录
        // ============================================================
        function saveHistoryRecord(cards) {
            if (!cards || cards.length === 0) return;
            const record = {
                id: Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
                timestamp: Date.now(),
                mode: currentMode,
                cards: cards.map(c => ({ ...c })), // 深拷贝
                summary: HistoryManager.makeSummary({ mode: currentMode, cards })
            };
            HistoryManager.save(record);
            updateHistoryUI();
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  历史记录 UI
        // ============================================================
        function updateHistoryUI() {
            const records = HistoryManager.getAll();
            historyCount.textContent = records.length;

            if (records.length === 0) {
                historyList.innerHTML = `<div class="history-empty">✦ 尚未留下占卜记录 ✦</div>`;
                return;
            }

            let html = '';
            records.forEach(record => {
                const time = new Date(record.timestamp);
                const timeStr =
                    `${time.getFullYear()}/${String(time.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}/${String(time.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(time.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(time.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
                const modeLabel = record.mode === 'single' ? '单张' : '三张';
                const cardNames = record.cards.map(c =>
                    `<span class="name-chip">${c.symbol} ${c.name}</span>`
                ).join('');

                html += `
                    <div class="history-item" data-id="${record.id}">
                        <div class="info">
                            <div class="time">${timeStr}</div>
                            <div class="cards-summary">
                                <span class="mode-tag">${modeLabel}</span>
                                <span class="card-names">${cardNames}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;">
                            <span class="action">↻ 查看</span>
                            <button class="delete-btn" data-id="${record.id}" title="删除这条记录">✕</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            historyList.innerHTML = html;

            // 事件：点击记录查看详情
            historyList.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(item => {
                item.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    if (e.target.closest('.delete-btn')) return;
                    const id = this.dataset.id;
                    const record = HistoryManager.getAll().find(r => r.id === id);
                    if (record) {
                        viewHistoryRecord(record);
                    }
                });
            });

            // 事件：删除按钮
            historyList.querySelectorAll('.delete-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const id = this.dataset.id;
                    if (confirm('确定要删除这条占卜记录吗？')) {
                        HistoryManager.delete(id);
                        updateHistoryUI();
                        // 如果当前查看的正好是这条，重置牌桌
                        if (currentIsHistory && currentCards.length > 0) {
                            const firstCard = currentCards[0];
                            if (firstCard && firstCard.id && firstCard.id === id) {
                                resetTable();
                            }
                        }
                        // 更新计数
                        historyCount.textContent = HistoryManager.count();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  查看历史记录详情
        // ============================================================
        function viewHistoryRecord(record) {
            if (isDrawing) return;
            const cards = record.cards;
            const count = cards.length;
            // 根据记录中的牌数量决定模式显示
            const labels = count === 1 ? ['✦ 历史占卜 ✦'] : ['✧ 过去', '✧ 现在', '✧ 未来'];
            // 临时切换模式显示，但不改变 currentMode
            renderCards(cards, labels);
            // 显示解读
            setTimeout(() => {
                showReading(cards);
                currentIsHistory = true;
                // 高亮当前查看的记录
                document.querySelectorAll('.history-item').forEach(el => {
                    el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(212,167,74,0)';
                    if (el.dataset.id === record.id) {
                        el.style.borderColor = 'rgba(212,167,74,0.4)';
                        el.style.background = 'rgba(212,167,74,0.05)';
                    } else {
                        el.style.background = '';
                    }
                });
            }, 400);
        }

        // ============================================================
        //  历史面板折叠
        // ============================================================
        let historyOpen = false;

        function toggleHistoryPanel() {
            historyOpen = !historyOpen;
            historyBody.classList.toggle('open', historyOpen);
            historyArrow.classList.toggle('open', historyOpen);
            if (historyOpen) {
                updateHistoryUI();
            }
        }

        function closeHistoryPanel() {
            historyOpen = false;
            historyBody.classList.remove('open');
            historyArrow.classList.remove('open');
        }

        historyToggle.addEventListener('click', toggleHistoryPanel);

        // ============================================================
        //  清空记录
        // ============================================================
        clearHistoryBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (HistoryManager.count() === 0) return;
            if (confirm('确定要清空所有占卜记录吗？此操作不可撤销。')) {
                HistoryManager.clear();
                updateHistoryUI();
                historyCount.textContent = 0;
                if (currentIsHistory) {
                    resetTable();
                }
            }
        });

        // ============================================================
        //  抽卡按钮 & 键盘快捷键
        // ============================================================
        drawBtn.addEventListener('click', performDraw);

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.code === 'Space' && !e.repeat) {

                performDraw();
            }
        });

        // ============================================================
        //  初始化
        // ============================================================
        renderCards([]);
        updateHistoryUI();
        historyCount.textContent = HistoryManager.count();

        console.log('✦ 塔罗秘仪 · 已加载 ✦');

        console.log(`✦ 当前记录数: ${HistoryManager.count()}`);
    </script>
